vulnerability.name: Remote Code Execution
vulnerability.description: Vulnerabilities allowing execution of arbitrary code
vulnerability.impact: Complete system compromise, data theft, or service disruption
vulnerability.mitigation: Avoid dangerous functions, use allowlists for commands, validate and sanitize all inputs

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The constructor instantiates a contract (Bank) from an external address without validating the code first, potentially allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary code.
findings.execution_path_diagram:
```
1. Call constructor ModifierEntrancy()
2. Create new instance of Bank contract at 0x<hash>
3. Attacker calls a function in the Bank contract containing Remote Code Execution vulnerability
```
exploitation_steps: Interact with the instantiated Bank contract containing RCE
findings.exploitation_conditions: Attacker must interact with a vulnerable instance of the Bank contract
findings.remediation: Validate and sanitize all inputs, use allowlists for commands, and avoid instantiating external contracts without proper authorization.
findings.secure_code_example: // Instantiate Bank contract using a factory with proper validation and authorization checks

findings.title: Remote Code Execution vulnerability
findings.explanation: The contract calls 'msg.sender.call.value()' function without proper input validation, allowing arbitrary code execution.
exploitation_steps: Send a transaction with a custom function call as the 'amount'
The contract executes this arbitrary code
findings.exploitation_conditions: An attacker must be able to interact with the contract
findings.remediation: Validate and sanitize all inputs, avoid dangerous functions like 'eval' or 'require', use allowlists for commands.
